name: Natal Chart Reading
purpose: A first look at your birth chart as a whole, together with the important transits, progressions, and current conditions surrounding the life you're living now.
method: We begin with the natal chart as the foundation, then bring in relevant transits, progressions, and other timing techniques to understand what is active now. I guide the conversation and explain what I'm seeing; your questions and feedback help us discover how those patterns are actually showing up in your life.
bestFor: New clients: this is the reading that establishes our shared understanding of your chart
A first professional reading when you want the whole pattern, not an app-style list of placements
A meaningful crossroads, recurring pattern, or season of change that could use a wider view
notFor: Existing clients wanting a focused follow-up: Want More Clarity or a Quick Check-In fits better
A consultation focused on two people's charts together: choose the Relationship Consultation

options.label: 90 minutes: the full tour
options.note: Recommended for first readings: more room for the natal chart, current conditions, and your questions.

intakeRequirements: Exact birth time (birth certificate if possible)
The focus you want, via the intake form after booking
includes: A whole-chart natal interpretation focused on how the pieces work together
Relevant transits, progressions, and current planetary conditions around your natal chart
Your chosen focus, set in advance through the intake form
A guided conversation with room for as much or as little feedback as feels natural to you
deliverables: A copy of your natal chart
preparation: Confirm your birth time from a birth certificate if you can
Bring two or three real questions you're living with
